decision.explanation: Documents d00, d01, and d02 explicitly identify Dean Martin as the artist of the 1967 studio album 'Welcome to My World', while document d05 identifies Elvis Presley as the artist of a 1977 compilation album with the same title; document d04 contains contradictory text attributing the album to Frank Sinatra but includes a chronology listing 'Happiness Is Dean Martin' immediately preceding it, suggesting a data error rather than a valid alternative, and document d03 appears to be a hallucinated or erroneous claim regarding Elton John.
